Project list

Adjust how imported projects are flagged and how many list pages Refresh pulls. Open the projects workspace.

days

Adds a local canceled flag when a project has had no recorded activity for this many days. Default 180. This is a local heuristic, not proof another expert was hired.

pages

0 pulls every page (recommended the first time). Later, 1 or 2 updates only the newest pages.

Estimate defaults

Used on the Estimate screen. PERT formulas themselves are not changed here.

$

Default hourly rate on the Estimate screen.

Controls how Estimate applies contractor and client fees. Same three options as before.

Codeable connection

Sign-in obtains a user-specific token used only for read-only Refresh. Your password is not stored.

This plugin does not send messages, estimates, or payouts, and it does not write to workrooms. Local notes and color flags stay in WordPress.

The email you use on app.codeable.io

Used once to obtain a token. The password is not saved.
Saved data

Disconnected — showing saved data. Refresh is off until you sign in again. Saved projects, clients, notes, and profile stay until you use Clear all data.

Clear all data

Comments backfill (read-only)

Loads each imported project’s description and every accessible comments page into the local cache. Uses the same documented GETs as Load from Codeable. Nothing is posted to Codeable. Pagination stays evidence-backed: a 50-item page is not treated as complete.

This job uses WordPress WP-Cron (a scheduled single event after each tick, plus the existing hourly hook). Default WP-Cron only runs when someone visits the site. The browser does not need to stay on this page, but the site needs traffic or a real cron hitting wp-cron.php. Run one batch now processes one bounded tick immediately.

Author names and public/private visibility stay empty/unknown until a live keys-only shape shows those fields. This plugin does not invent them.
